challenge.method: Compared a complete 1.1-or-later notice designating no features, a notice with zero Invariant Sections and one Cover Text, and an unavailable notice. Also tested a single-edition grant with all three categories empty.
challenge.results: The complete all-absent case fits. A single Front-Cover Text or Back-Cover Text defeats the selection. Missing text leaves absence unverified. A 1.1-only grant fails the edition condition despite satisfying every feature condition. An unpublished later draft falls outside section 10.

limitations: The comment spells this variant GFDL-1.1-or-later-no-invariants and reverses the positive alternative as well. The typed field resolves that discrepancy.
An unavailable or incomplete notice cannot establish three absences. The publisher's Addendum gives separate example wording for each absence.
